claim: Thyanbo Tsho (the lake that burst above Thame on 16 Aug 2024) is NOT on the ICIMOD/UNDP 2020 list of 47 potentially dangerous glacial lakes.

conclusion.basis: Zero textual occurrences of Thyanbo/Thyangbo/Thame/Thengbo in a report where the control terms Imja, Tsho Rolpa, Thulagi and Lumding all appear; and all 47 lake-ID centroids parsed, with the nearest (Lumding, 86.612E 27.779N) 5.76 km from Thyanbo and separately named in the report.
conclusion.important_caveat: NOT on the PDGL list does NOT mean unknown to science. The 2020 inventory screened lakes down to 0.003 km2 and applied dam/glacier/surroundings criteria; Thyanbo's absence reflects the screening criteria, not an absence of any prior observation. This distinction must survive into the sitrep text.

evidence.id_encoding: GL<lon*1000>E<lat*1000>N, per the report's own lake-ID section
